title.description: Wordmark text, page titles and social cards

description.description: Meta description and the default social card text

url.message: must be an http or https address with no path, such as https://links.example.com
url.description: The deployed origin, used for absolute social card URLs and canonical links

language.message: must be a non-empty language code such as en

socialImage.message: must be an image path or null
socialImage.description: Default social card image, used for the home page and for items with no preview image. A .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif or .webp file inside the repo, relative to the repo root, whose content matches its extension

items.message: must be an id using lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

order.message: must be a list of collection ids
order.description: Collection ids in display order. Collections not listed come after, alphabetically

default.message: must be a collection id or null
default.description: The collection shown at the site root. Null means the first collection

brand.description: Brand colours. Drives poster inks and the default accent roles in the scene

primary.description: Primary brand colours, at least one. Each is an object with a name and a hex value. Poster rules and type dots refer to them by name and position
primary.message: must have at least one colour

items.description: One brand colour with a name and a hex value

name.message: must be a non-empty colour name
name.description: Colour name, used by poster rules such as avoidPairs and excludeFromPosters

value.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e

secondary.description: Secondary brand colours, may be empty. Same shape as primary. Used as poster inks and for some type dots

items.description: One brand colour with a name and a hex value

name.message: must be a non-empty colour name
name.description: Colour name, used by poster rules such as avoidPairs and excludeFromPosters

value.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e

accent.description: Accent brand colours, may be empty. Same shape as primary. Used as poster inks, the focus ring and some type dots

items.description: One brand colour with a name and a hex value

name.message: must be a non-empty colour name
name.description: Colour name, used by poster rules such as avoidPairs and excludeFromPosters

value.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e

light.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e
light.description: Light neutral. Poster paper, and the light text colour on dark fills

dark.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e
dark.description: Dark neutral. The dark text colour on light fills, and poster paper on the inverse set

surface.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e
surface.description: Surface neutral, a second paper tone for posters. Derived from the light and dark neutrals when omitted

muted.message: must be a hex colour such as #e4572e
muted.description: Muted neutral, a quiet mid tone. Derived from the light and dark neutrals when omitted

fonts.description: The four main font roles, as Google Fonts family names. Self hosting serves the same families from your own site

display.message: must be a non-empty font family name

body.message: must be a non-empty font family name

mono.message: must be a non-empty font family name

poster.message: must be a non-empty font family name
poster.description: Poster title band and poster type

advanced.description: Everything else, defaulting to the Curator design

fonts.description: Extra font roles and font loading

typewriter.message: must be a non-empty font family name
typewriter.description: Slide label font for typed labels

handwriting.message: must be a non-empty font family name
handwriting.description: Slide label font for handwritten labels

source.description: google loads from Google Fonts. self downloads the font files at build time and serves them from the output folder

googleFontsUrl.message: must be an https address or null
googleFontsUrl.description: Overrides the Google Fonts URL the build generates, for custom weights or axes. When set, the family check against Google Fonts is skipped

posters.description: Poster generation for items without an image

items.message: must be a pair of colour names

avoidPairs.message: must be a list of colour name pairs
avoidPairs.description: Pairs of colour names that never appear together in a poster, for example [["Lime", "Orange"]]

excludeFromPosters.message: must be a list of colour names
excludeFromPosters.description: Brand colours never used as poster ink or paper

inverseShare.message: must be a number from 0 to 1
inverseShare.description: Share of posters printed on dark paper, a primary colour or the dark neutral

primaryShare.message: must be a number from 0 to 1
primaryShare.description: Target share of primary colours across a collection's posters

minContrast.message: must be a number from 1 to 21
minContrast.description: Minimum ink to paper contrast ratio

compositions.message: must be "all" or a list of composition numbers from 1 to 16
compositions.description: all, or a list of composition numbers 1 to 16 to allow

name.message: must be an id using lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens
name.description: Which scene folder in src/scenes to mount. Only lighttable ships

pageSize.message: must be a whole number from 1 to 100

motion.description: Motion level. normal is the full design, fast shortens animations, off removes them

colors.message: must be an object of colour overrides
colors.description: Overrides for any scene colour token, keyed by token name without the leading dashes, for example table-frame-top. Brand-driven role tokens cannot be overridden

images.description: Image fetching behaviour. Links to local or private network addresses are never fetched and get a poster

fetch.description: Fetch preview images at build time

timeoutMs.message: must be a whole number of milliseconds from 1000 to 120000
timeoutMs.description: Timeout for each image request in milliseconds

maxBytes.message: must be a whole number of bytes from 10000 to 50000000

fitDomains.message: must be a list of hostnames
fitDomains.description: Hostnames whose images are shown fitted rather than cropped

additionalProperties.message: must be an object with optional label and dot

label.description: Display label for the type, used on the slide and the open screen

dot.message: must be a colour role such as primary.0, secondary.0 or accent.0
dot.description: Dot colour role for the type, a tier and a zero based index. primary.0 is primary 1 and accent.1 is accent 2

types.message: must be an object keyed by type name
types.description: Per-type overrides keyed by type name, each with an optional label and dot. The dot is a colour role such as accent.1

outDir.message: must be a relative folder path such as dist
outDir.description: Output folder, relative to the repo root

itemPages.description: Write a page for each item. Turn off only for very large sites: item links then load through 404.html, with a not found status and no item preview card
